BOS.note: Tatum returns from Achilles. Paul George acquired. Managing repeater tax, limited flexibility.

DET.note: Young core, cap flexibility, draft picks. Strong buyer at deadline.

MIA.note: Significant cap flexibility and draft assets. Buyer at deadline. Young core.

ORL.note: Capped at first apron with young core. Limited trade flexibility. Buyer at deadline.

PHI.note: Capped out with three max contracts. Limited flexibility, near first apron. Stand-pat.

TOR.note: Kawhi Leonard returns, but injury concerns persist. Buyer at deadline.

HOU.note: Durant and young core. Expiring contracts and picks for trades. Buyer.

MIN.note: Hard-capped at second apron. Limited flexibility. Gobert/Randle are trade chips.

NOP.note: Under tax, young core. Poole's contract is a trade chip. Buyer at deadline.

POR.note: Young core, acquired Ja Morant. Lillard returning from Achilles. Trade-focused.

SAS.note: Deep young core on cheap deals. Significant cap flexibility. Buyer at deadline.
